_comment: Allowlist for HEADLESS Claude Code runs (builds/cc_driver drives `claude -p`
with stdin closed). --permission-mode acceptEdits auto-approves FILE EDITS
only; Bash/PowerShell still raise a permission request, and with no stdin
there is nothing to answer it, so those calls are denied.
Scar 2026-08-30: without this, a work order that says 'include tests you
actually RUN' comes back with the tests unrun, rc=0, and lands in done/
looking successful -- the exact fabricated-compliance failure COSMOS canon
Scope is deliberately narrow: read, verify and test. No install, no network
fetch, no schtasks, no service control, no deletion. An agent that needs one
of those should have to ask a human.
